question_vi: Soft delete và audit timestamps với TypeORM — createdAt, updatedAt, deletedAt?
question_en: Soft delete and audit timestamps with TypeORM — createdAt, updatedAt, deletedAt?
answer_html_vi:
TypeORM cung cấp decorators tiện lợi cho timestamps và soft delete:

typescript
import {
  CreateDateColumn, UpdateDateColumn, DeleteDateColumn,
  PrimaryGeneratedColumn, Column, Entity,
} from 'typeorm';

@Entity()
export class BaseEntity {
  @PrimaryGeneratedColumn('uuid')
  id: string;

  @CreateDateColumn()  // Tự set khi INSERT
  createdAt: Date;

  @UpdateDateColumn()  // Tự update khi UPDATE
  updatedAt: Date;

  @DeleteDateColumn()  // Tự set khi softDelete(), NULL khi active
  deletedAt: Date | null;
}

Soft delete với TypeORM:

typescript
// Soft delete — set deletedAt
await this.repo.softDelete(id);

// Restore
await this.repo.restore(id);

// find() tự động filter deletedAt IS NULL
// Để include deleted:
await this.repo.find({ withDeleted: true });

Lưu ý: @DeleteDateColumn chỉ hoạt động khi dùng softDelete() và softRemove() — không phải delete() hay remove().
answer_html_en:
TypeORM ships convenient decorators for timestamps and soft delete:

typescript
import {
  CreateDateColumn, UpdateDateColumn, DeleteDateColumn,
  PrimaryGeneratedColumn, Column, Entity,
} from 'typeorm';

@Entity()
export class BaseEntity {
  @PrimaryGeneratedColumn('uuid')
  id: string;

  @CreateDateColumn()  // set automatically on INSERT
  createdAt: Date;

  @UpdateDateColumn()  // set automatically on UPDATE
  updatedAt: Date;

  @DeleteDateColumn()  // set by softDelete(), NULL while active
  deletedAt: Date | null;
}

Soft delete with TypeORM:

typescript
// soft delete — sets deletedAt
await this.repo.softDelete(id);

// restore
await this.repo.restore(id);

// find() filters deletedAt IS NULL automatically
// to include deleted rows:
await this.repo.find({ withDeleted: true });

Note: @DeleteDateColumn only kicks in with softDelete() and softRemove() — not delete() or remove().
